priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. general.title: SpaceX-Tesla Combination ‘Extremely Tangible,’ Ferragu Says

Elon Musk openly endorsed the idea Tuesday, saying the boards of both companies had formed special committees of independent directors to consider the proposal. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
